articles.title: “5-Second Heist”: Thief Steals Full LPG Cylinder in Broad Daylight in Basti
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking theft incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Basti, where a thief stole a full LPG cylinder from a house within seconds in broad daylight. The incident took place on Wednesday afternoon under the Kotwali police station limits and was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A shocking theft incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Basti, where a thief stole a full LPG cylinder from a house within seconds in broad daylight.

The incident took place on Wednesday afternoon under the Kotwali police station limits and was captured on CCTV. The footage, which surfaced on Thursday, shows the accuse entering the house and escaping with the cylinder in just about five seconds.

Swift and Targeted Theft:
According to the homeowner, Rahul Pal, the main gate of the house was open when a youth dressed like a delivery boy entered. Wearing a red-collared T-shirt and black pants, he went straight to the kitchen, picked up the filled cylinder kept near the doorway, hoisted it onto his shoulder, and fled.

CCTV footage indicates that the suspect had been loitering in the area for some time, conducting recce before executing the theft.

Only Cylinder Targeted:
Despite valuables and parked bikes being present, the thief did not touch anything else, suggesting he specifically targeted the LPG cylinder.

Shortage Angle:
The victim stated that he had purchased the cylinder just two days earlier after considerable effort, allegedly paying nearly three times the usual price due to an ongoing shortage.

Police Action:
Kotwali police have registered a case and are examining CCTV footage to identify the accused. Officials said efforts are underway to arrest the accuse and recover the stolen cylinder.

#Basti #LPGTheft #CCTV #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh

articles.title: “Instagram Reel Sparks Gun Battle”: BJP Youth Leaders Clash, Firing in Aligarh Market
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of violence has emerged from Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh, where two groups allegedly linked to the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) clashed over an Instagram reel, leading to heavy firing in a crowded market.

body.html:
A shocking incident of violence has emerged from Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh, where two groups allegedly linked to the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) clashed over an Instagram reel, leading to heavy firing in a crowded market.

The incident took place on March 12 in the Sarai Hakim area, but the video surfaced on Thursday, triggering fresh outrage.

Reel Row Turns Violent

According to police, the dispute began after a comment was posted on an Instagram reel shared by Harshad Hindu, reportedly a BJYM office-bearer. The comment, allegedly made by Mohit Sharma, led to a heated exchange and abusive phone calls between the two groups.

Tensions escalated when members of Harshad’s group allegedly assaulted Mohit in Mahavirganj, prompting both sides to gather supporters anticipating retaliation.

Indiscriminate Firing

On the evening of March 12, both groups came face-to-face in Sarai Hakim market, leading to indiscriminate firing. Police said around 12 rounds were fired within 23 seconds, causing panic among locals.

Three people—identified as Shoaib Ahmed, Shanu Valmiki, and Ayush Sharma—sustained bullet injuries. One was shot in the abdomen, while two others suffered injuries to their legs. All were rushed to hospital.

Police Action

So far, 13 accused have been arrested and sent to jail. Among them, injured history-sheeters Shoaib Ahmed and Shanu Valmiki were arrested after treatment.

Police are analysing CCTV and viral video footage to identify other suspects. Raids are underway to nab the main absconding accused, including Mohit Sharma, Aman Pandit, Prakhar Rathi, and Mannu Pandit.

Investigation Ongoing

Officials said both groups were allegedly involved in illegal activities, and strict action will be taken. The incident has raised serious concerns over rising gang violence and misuse of social media disputes escalating into armed clashes.

articles.title: “Wrong Side, Right Fist?”: Road Rage Clash at Bengaluru Campus Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A road rage incident at the GKVK campus in Bengaluru has sparked concern after a car driver allegedly assaulted a biker who questioned him for driving on the wrong side. The incident, which reportedly occurred in the presence of police personnel, has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A road rage incident at the GKVK campus in Bengaluru has sparked concern after a car driver allegedly assaulted a biker who questioned him for driving on the wrong side.

The incident, which reportedly occurred in the presence of police personnel, has gone viral on social media.

Argument Turns Violent

According to reports, the confrontation began when the biker objected to the car driver entering from the wrong side on a service road near the campus. What started as a verbal exchange quickly escalated into a physical fight.

Eyewitnesses said both men exchanged blows, with the car driver allegedly attacking the biker aggressively even as bystanders tried to intervene.

Bystander Drawn In

An autorickshaw driver who attempted to defuse the situation was also pulled into the scuffle, further escalating tensions. The clash continued for several minutes in full public view before it was brought under control.

Public Reaction

The viral video has triggered strong reactions online, with many raising concerns over rising road rage incidents and lack of discipline among motorists in Bengaluru.

Action Likely

Authorities are expected to take cognisance of the footage and initiate appropriate action against those involved.

The incident underscores the urgent need for stricter traffic enforcement and better conflict management on city roads.

articles.title: “Divorce Denied, Life Destroyed”: Woman Partially Blinded in toilet cleaner Attack by Husband
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 29-year-old woman suffered partial loss of eyesight after her estranged husband allegedly hurled toilet cleaner at her following a chase in Pallavaram, Chennai. According to sources, the victim has lost around 50% vision in her right eye and is currently unable to open her left eye.

body.html:
A 29-year-old woman suffered partial loss of eyesight after her estranged husband allegedly hurled toilet cleaner at her following a chase in Pallavaram, Chennai.

According to sources, the victim has lost around 50% vision in her right eye and is currently unable to open her left eye. Doctors are still assessing whether her vision can be restored.

History of Abuse Alleged:
The accused, Mohamed Ali (31), a tea master from Kundrathur, had reportedly been involved in frequent domestic disputes with the woman, a sales executive. The couple, married for six years with a four-year-old daughter, had been living separately due to his alleged alcohol addiction, suspicion, and repeated abuse.

The victim alleged that despite multiple attempts to file complaints earlier, she was allegedly advised by police to “compromise” instead of registering formal cases.

Attack After Heated Argument:
Police said Ali visited the woman’s parents’ house on Sunday night when she was alone. During an argument over divorce, he allegedly refused to agree and forced her to continue the relationship.

As tensions escalated, he reportedly chased her onto the street and threw toilet cleaner on her face before fleeing.

Victim’s Account:
The woman stated that the accused had a history of violence, including physical assault, strangulation attempts, and threats against her and their child. She alleged that he attacked her saying her face was the reason she could work and that he would “take that away.”

Police Action:
Passersby rushed the victim to a private eye hospital in Poonamallee. Based on her complaint, Pallavaram police arrested the accused from Zamin Pallavaram.

He has been booked under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, including provisions related to toilet cleaner attack, and remanded to Puzhal prison.

Medical Update:
Hospital authorities confirmed significant damage to one eye, while the other remains under observation. Fortunately, no major burns were reported on other parts of her body.

The incident has raised serious concerns over domestic violence and alleged lapses in earlier police intervention.

#Chennai #DomesticViolence #WomenSafety #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #JusticeForVictim #IndiaNews

articles.title: “Swap Scam Exposed”: Man Steals Gold Rings Using Imitation Trick, Arrested in Hyderabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kukatpally police have arrested a 30-year-old man for allegedly stealing gold rings from prominent jewellery stores by swapping them with imitation pieces.

body.html:
Kukatpally police have arrested a 30-year-old man for allegedly stealing gold rings from prominent jewellery stores by swapping them with imitation pieces.

The accused, identified as Merugu Sagar from Ameenpur in Sangareddy district, was nabbed following an investigation into thefts reported at major jewellery outlets, including CMR and Malabar Gold, earlier this year.

Clever Theft Modus Operandi:
According to police, the incidents occurred on January 23 and February 2. The accused would pose as a customer and ask to see gold rings. While the staff were distracted, he allegedly replaced the original rings with fake rolled-gold imitations concealed in his shirt pocket and left the store unnoticed.

Police Investigation:
Cases were registered at Kukatpally police station under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, with a similar case also filed at Punjagutta police station.

Using CCTV footage and technical evidence, police tracked down and arrested the accused.

Recovery and Probe:
Officials recovered three stolen gold rings weighing around 32 grams from his possession. Further investigation is underway to check if he was involved in more such incidents.

#Hyderabad #JewelleryTheft #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #PoliceAction #GoldScam #IndiaNews

articles.title: “Tarzan on Road?”: Shirtless Bike Stunt Lands Gorakhpur Youths in Police Net
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two young men in Uttar Pradesh’s Gorakhpur were arrested after a video of them performing dangerous bike stunts went viral on social media. The incident reportedly took place in the PPganj area, where the duo filmed themselves riding a Bullet motorcycle recklessly on a public road.

body.html:
Two young men in Uttar Pradesh’s Gorakhpur were arrested after a video of them performing dangerous bike stunts went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place in the PPganj area, where the duo filmed themselves riding a Bullet motorcycle recklessly on a public road.

Viral Stunt Video:
In the video, one youth is seen riding the bike shirtless, showing off his physique while repeatedly calling himself “Tarzan.” He is also seen briefly taking his hands off the handlebars, while another youth records the act.

The video quickly spread online, with several users tagging Gorakhpur Police and raising concerns over public safety.

Police Action:
Taking cognisance, PPganj police identified and detained the accused—Deepu Dubey from Tajdih village and Ansh Kumar Srivastava from Rajabari village. The motorcycle used in the stunt has also been seized.

Safety Concerns:
Locals have criticised such reckless behaviour, stating that such stunts on public roads endanger not only the riders but also innocent commuters.

Police said further legal action is underway.

articles.title: Gangster Who Threatened to Kill Cops Dies in Bihar Encounter, Constable Martyred
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic police encounter in Bihar’s Motihari ended with the death of a notorious criminal who had openly challenged the police, but not before a police constable lost his life in the line of duty.

body.html:
A dramatic police encounter in Bihar’s Motihari ended with the death of a notorious criminal who had openly challenged the police, but not before a police constable lost his life in the line of duty.

The accused, identified as Kundan Thakur, along with his associate Priyanshu Dubey, was killed during the late-night operation carried out by police in East Champaran district.

Viral Threat Audio:
An audio clip of Kundan Thakur, recorded two days before the encounter, has surfaced, in which he is heard daring the police. In the call to a Chakia police officer, he warned that several policemen would die in an encounter while he would escape.

He also accused police of harassing his family and threatened retaliation, claiming he would confront officers head-on rather than flee.

Encounter Turns Deadly:
According to police, a special team had set up a blockade after receiving inputs about Thakur’s location. When officers reached the spot, they were met with heavy gunfire from the criminals.

During the exchange, an STF jawan sustained critical injuries and was later declared dead at the hospital, triggering grief within the force.

Police retaliated in self-defence, leading to the deaths of Kundan Thakur and his associate at the scene.

Arrests and Probe:
East Champaran SP Swarn Prabhat said the gangster had been under surveillance for a long time, and multiple attempts were made to arrest him earlier.

Police also arrested the house owner, Ujjwal Kumar, and his father for allegedly sheltering the criminals. Further interrogation is underway.

A heavy police deployment has been made in the area following the encounter.

#Bihar #Motihari #PoliceEncounter #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: “₹7,000 for Gas?”: Noida HP Agency Row Sparks Outrage After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversy has erupted in Noida after an HP Gas agency was accused of charging an alleged ₹7,000 for a single LPG connection, far above standard rates. The issue came to light after a woman recorded a video at the agency, which has since gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A controversy has erupted in Noida after an HP Gas agency was accused of charging an alleged ₹7,000 for a single LPG connection, far above standard rates.

The issue came to light after a woman recorded a video at the agency, which has since gone viral on social media.

Woman Alleges Threat While Filming

In the video, the woman questions the high charges, while a staff member is heard confronting her, asking, “Do you have the right to make a video?”—a remark widely perceived as intimidating.

Pricing Concerns

LPG connection charges are typically regulated and include security deposit, regulator cost, and administrative fees. The alleged ₹7,000 demand has raised serious concerns about overcharging and lack of transparency.

Social Media Backlash

The clip has triggered widespread outrage online, with users demanding strict action and accountability. Many have urged authorities to investigate the agency and ensure fair pricing for consumers.

Consumer Awareness

Experts advise customers to verify official rates, insist on proper receipts, and report any irregularities to consumer forums.

Awaiting Response

No official statement has been issued so far by the agency or authorities. The incident continues to gain traction, increasing pressure for action.

#Noida #LPGScam #ConsumerRights #HPGas #BreakingNews

articles.title: Student Attacked with Machete Outside Pune College, Weapon Lodged in Head
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A college student was critically injured after being attacked with a koyta (machete) in broad daylight in Pune’s Wagholi area following a minor dispute. The incident occurred around 3:30 PM on March 12 near the Akhand Amruttulya tea stall outside the Raisoni College gate.

body.html:
A college student was critically injured after being attacked with a koyta (machete) in broad daylight in Pune’s Wagholi area following a minor dispute.

The incident occurred around 3:30 PM on March 12 near the Akhand Amruttulya tea stall outside the Raisoni College gate. The entire attack was captured on CCTV cameras.

Sudden Escalation

The घायल student, identified as Nagesh Sunil Jagtap, had stopped at the tea stall with friends when the accused, Mangesh Sangale and Pawan Rathod, reached the spot. They allegedly confronted him over abusive remarks, leading to a heated argument.

The situation quickly turned violent, with the accused attacking Jagtap using a koyta. One of the blows was so severe that the weapon got lodged in his head, leaving him critically injured.

Emergency Treatment

The brutal attack triggered panic in the area. Jagtap was rushed to a nearby hospital by friends and locals, where doctors performed emergency surgery to remove the weapon. He survived the procedure and is currently undergoing treatment.

Accused Arrested

Police registered a case and, using CCTV footage and local inputs, traced and arrested both accused. Further investigation is underway to ascertain the exact motive and check for the involvement of others.

The incident has sparked fear among residents in Wagholi.

#Pune #Wagholi #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

body.html:

Always assess road conditions before speeding or overtaking.
